window-1.title: WindowSwap
window-1.blurb: It drops you into a stranger's window somewhere in the world — ten minutes of someone's laundry line in Tellaro or rain on a Seoul balcony — and it's quiet, weirdly moving, and endlessly re-openable, plus it was built by a couple right there in Singapore.

window-2.title: The end of short-form content — Embedded
window-2.blurb: Kate Lindsay calls the time of death on the endless scroll and makes the case for going long — which feels like permission for exactly the kind of elaborate, deep-dive side quests you already throw yourself into.

window-3.title: Golden Hour Chrysanthemum Mocktail
window-3.blurb: It takes the dried chrysanthemum flowers sitting in your grandma's tea tin and shakes them into something golden and bar-worthy with maple and lemon — heritage drink, full persona change.

window-4.title: Inside Jen Mankins' Scandi-Inspired Brooklyn Brownstone, Redone
window-4.blurb: This one's the home of the woman who built Brooklyn's coolest indie boutique, so every corner has that shop-owner's eye — collected, warm, zero showroom energy — and I think you'll steal at least three ideas from the small details.
